title: Carrow Fields Foundation: how large a 3-month variance swap program the volatility sleeve can add from January 2027, and the sleeve's 2027 cash plan
domain: Quantitative Finance and Trading, Quantitative Finance

sources.origin: Cboe Global Markets, index history downloads (U.S. indices, daily prices). Used as is: each file ships byte for byte as downloaded.
sources.license: Published by Cboe Global Markets for public download. The values are facts, reproduced unaltered with the source and the pull date recorded. The S&P 500 is a product of S&P Dow Jones Indices, whose closing levels Cboe republishes in the same download.

sources.origin: the New York Stock Exchange's published holiday and early-close schedule for 2026 to 2028, transcribed
written for this task. The foundation, its dealers, custodian, people, positions and paperwork are invented; every market value in them is computed from the published closes above.

cross_check_source.series: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, FRED, series VXVCLS (CBOE S&P 500 3-Month Volatility Index, daily close)
cross_check_source.what: The same index as VIX3M_History.csv, published back to 2007-12-04 (the Cboe download begins 2009-09-18) and equal to it on every day both carry. Held in the generator beside the pulls, outside the pack, and read by no golden figure; every graded band is checked to contain the answer obtained with it.
